name: SDcompliesWithProfile
title: StructureDefinition Complies With Profile
description: Asserts that instances that are valid against the profile declaring this extension are also automatically valid against the StructureDefinition referenced by this extension.

element.short: Dependent Profiles - must be valid against these too
element.definition: Asserts that instances that are valid against the profile declaring this extension are also automatically valid against the StructureDefinition referenced by this extension.
element.comment: This is a claim that instances that comply with the profile containing this extension also comply with the profile it refers to. Note that this claim may not be true if it is tested.
